alerts.title: Uncontrolled hypothyroidism despite levothyroxine
alerts.message: Patient has TSH 12.4 mIU/L (target below 4.5) with low Free T4, confirming persistent hypothyroidism. She reports often forgetting her thyroid tablet, which is the likely primary cause. Symptoms include tiredness, feeling cold, constipation, dry skin, periorbital puffiness, and delayed ankle reflexes—all classic hypothyroid features. Hypothyroidism itself causes weight gain and can elevate LDL and triglycerides. The clinician plans to switch DTG for weight gain, but much of the weight gain (9 kg over 1 year) and dyslipidaemia may be attributable to untreated hypothyroidism rather than DTG. The guideline excerpt notes the DTG-weight-gain association may not be causal. Optimising levothyroxine adherence and dose should precede any ART change.

evidence.recommended_action: Address levothyroxine adherence and up-titrate dose to normalise TSH before attributing weight gain to DTG. Reassess symptoms and lipids after TSH normalises.

alerts.title: Dyslipidaemia and hyperglycaemia risk with BMI 33
alerts.message: Guidelines require checking glucose when 2+ hyperglycaemia risk factors are present (age ≥30, BMI ≥25). This patient has BMI 33 and age 45. Fasting glucose 5.6 mmol/L is borderline. LDL 4.2, total cholesterol 6.4, and triglycerides 2.3 mmol/L are all elevated. TDF can contribute to lipid abnormalities, and uncontrolled hypothyroidism worsens dyslipidaemia. DTG-associated weight gain may compound metabolic risk. The clinician's plan does not address the dyslipidaemia or cardiovascular risk.

evidence.recommended_action: Address dyslipidaemia: optimise thyroid function first, consider dietary intervention, and repeat lipid panel after TSH normalisation. Evaluate need for lipid-lowering therapy.

alerts.title: Viral load monitoring overdue per guideline schedule
alerts.message: Guidelines state patients on DTG-based first-line ART should have VL checked every 6 months, reducible to 12 monthly if VL <50 for >1 year with reliable adherence. Last VL was <50 on 2025-11-10, 106 days ago. While not yet critically overdue, no VL is ordered in today's plan. If the clinician is considering switching DTG, confirming virological suppression before any regimen change is essential.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm viral load is current before switching regimen. If last VL <50 was the first suppressed result, next VL due around May 2026 per 6-month schedule.
